title: Introduce range pins and immutable alias stability windows for model versions
creator: Asha Kapoor
description: Problem: Teams onboarding new models need finer-grained pin controls that balance safety and agility. Current pin options (exact ref by hash, single-tag, or explicit semver) force either too-strict immutability or too-lax automatic upgrades. We propose two complementary features: 1) semver-range pins (e.g., ^1.3.0, >=1.2 <2.0) in API/SDK so callers can accept safe minor/patch updates; 2) immutable alias bindings with configurable stability windows (an alias that can be rebound only after a configurable quarantine period unless explicitly forced). This provides automatic minor/patch updates for low-risk routes while protecting critical paths via alias quarantine and explicit force semantics.
proposal_summary: Add range pin parsing in server-side resolver and SDK helpers; introduce alias meta (immutable_until/ quarantine_seconds) stored in registry; extend model resolution precedence: explicit request pin > alias (if not quarantined) > semver-range > default-latest. Expose new API fields: pin_range, force_rebind, alias_quarantine_seconds. Publish performance profiles per concrete version and attach TTL to alias-bound profile to avoid stale metrics following rebinds.
api_changes: POST /v1/models/resolve accepts 'pin_range' field (string, semver range syntax) and returns resolved_version and resolution_trace
Model metadata includes 'published_profiles' with timestamp and 'profile_ttl_seconds'
sdk_changes: Add PinRange helper to SDKs to validate user-supplied ranges and produce resolution hints
Expose Model.resolvePinRange(range) convenience method in JS/Python SDKs
Provide opt-in client-side fallback logic to retry with looser range when server resolution fails (configurable)
runtime_requirements: Resolver must evaluate semver ranges against available concrete versions efficiently (index by semver lattice)
Alias records must store immutable_until timestamp and support soft-lock semantics for canary rollouts
Perf profile publish flow must atomically attach profile to a concrete version and update alias binding metadata with last_profile_timestamp
backcompat_and_migration: Existing exact-pin and tag semantics unchanged by default
Aliases created before rollout have quarantine_seconds=0 (legacy behavior)
Clients that depend on exact hashes will continue to function; SDK helpers are opt-in
We will run a compatibility migration for internal infra to index semver components for fast range queries
acceptance_criteria: Unit tests for semver range parsing and resolver corner cases (pre-release versions, build metadata)
Integration test: create alias with quarantine_seconds=86400, attempt rebind immediately -> fails unless force_rebind=true
SDKs return consistent resolution_trace strings showing precedence steps
Performance profile TTL prevents using an alias profile older than TTL after rebinds and triggers analytics alert when a stale profile is dropped
risks_and_mitigation: Complexity in resolver could increase latency: mitigate by caching recent range query results and adding instrumentation
Operators might misconfigure permissive ranges unintentionally: mitigate with lint warnings in SDK and console that estimate churn risk
Stale performance profiles could cause bad routing decisions: mitigate by profile TTL and dashboard alerts
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (canary): server-side resolver and JS SDK PinRange in internal staging; limited traffic to a small set of customers
Phase 2: enable alias quarantine knobs in Console UI and API; document recommended quarantine durations per risk profile
Phase 3: enable range pins in public SDKs and run migration to index versions for performance
Monitoring: add resolver latency SLI and profile-staleness metric; rollback knob to disable range evaluation
docs_and_communications: Public SDK changelog entries and migration guide
Console UX copy updates explaining alias quarantine and risk trade-offs
implementation_notes: Resolver: implement semver-range matching using existing semver lib; add caching layer keyed by (range, model-name, available-versions-sha)
Alias store: add 'immutable_until' timestamp field and 'last_forced_rebind' audit field
Perf profiles: attach version_sha and published_ts; add profile_ttl_seconds config default 86400
API: extend /models endpoints with resolution_trace returning list of human-readable steps for debugging
